title: Evaluating GPT-3.5's Awareness and Summarization Abilities for European Constitutional Texts with Shared Topics
reasoning: The paper evaluates GPT-3.5's ability to understand and summarize "European Constitutional Texts with Shared Topics," specifically "Rights and Duties." These topics inherently include fundamental moral and ethical concepts such as "Prohibition of slavery," "Prohibition of cruel treatment," "Human dignity," "Freedom of religion," and "Right to privacy," which are foundational to legal and societal ethics. The LLM's performance on these texts constitutes an evaluation of its handling of ethically relevant content.
